commands.command: Primary literature audit and locator verification (arXiv:2608.13144, arXiv:2408.03223, arXiv:2512.09786)
commands.purpose: Verify exact mathematical guarantees, target reference scope, and hardware assumptions

requirement_evidence.notes: Audited primary papers: LipCache (arXiv:2608.13144), StreamiNNC (arXiv:2408.03223), TinyDejaVu (arXiv:2512.09786).
Identified that LipCache guarantee is GuardNet-side only (Remark 5.2) and tested strictly on i.i.d. images (Sec 7.1).
Faithful adaptation requires training a separate GuardNet proxy, which is blocked by the frozen reference protocol.
Method M14 marked NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_FROZEN_SCOPE; comparator runtimes are explicitly not fabricated.
StreamiNNC and TinyDejaVu audited for streaming states and hardware constraints; marked AUDITED_APPLICABILITY_ONLY.
Locally inspired exact incremental computation is maintained under distinct method ID M03 with explicit SmallCNN1D evaluation.
Updated method statuses; latency/accuracy metrics held unpopulated (null) until empirical execution.

scientific_dispositions.evidence: No faithful head-to-head benchmark against LipCache is possible on frozen HAPT due to the GuardNet proxy training requirement and disparate guarantee objects.
Published prior works on certified caching either focus on external proxies for static images or uncertified embedded hardware designs.

limitations: Prior-work audit is analytical and literature-based. External comparator benchmarks are not run because they require modifying the frozen reference or training out-of-scope models.
